name: CTA401
description:
## Description

"This is a tube type pre-main amplifier from XENA AUDIO Co., which has a planning and design department in Copenhagen, Denmark and a main factory in Sweden.In the preamplifier section, by using a relay for the input selector, noise penetration from other lines is eliminated and a high S/N ratio is secured.It is also equipped with a full-scale phono equalizer using a vacuum tube.The power amplifier section adopts a push-pull configuration using four EL34/6CA7power stages.The power transformer uses an original coverless large toroidal transformer, low distortion EI core output transformer, 4� Ï‰ 8� independent speaker terminal for banana chip, etc. to realize a unique power stage structure.All the main parts use Golden Dragon vacuum tubes made by PM Component Company in England.Four 6CA7units are used in the power section, three 12AX7A units are used in the driver'Ωs first stage and phono equalizer section, and two 12AU7A units are used in the equalizer section.The front panel uses 8mm thick aluminum shavings with hairline finish, and the well-balanced knob on the front uses tapered aluminum shavings.The power cord uses a Verden shield type very thick power cord."

name: CTA301
description:
## Description

"Tube preamplifier using a vacuum tube.All signal switching circuits are done with palladium gold plated circuits attached to the circuit board to reasonably shorten the signal path and prevent adverse effects.For the equalizers compatible with both MM and MC cartridges, a CR-type passive equalizer is used because of the accuracy of equalization characteristics and the naturalness of sound perception. A high-output, low-distortion SRPP circuit is used in the front stage of the equalizer in a double-triode configuration.All power supply circuits are stabilized for each system, and film capacitors are used to prevent mutual interference, which is likely to occur in the ultra-high frequency range. In addition, the stabilization circuit includes an overload protection circuit.Three types of cathode bypass capacitors are used in parallel : electrolytic capacitors for low frequencies, tantalum capacitors for middle frequencies, and polypropylene capacitors for high frequencies.It uses a soft start that takes 20seconds to reach the required DC voltage after turning on the power switch.As a result, it is protected from excessive stress that suddenly comes in from a cold state, and it can operate reliably for a long time.The front panel has a hairline finish of 8mm thick machined aluminum, and the well-balanced knob also uses tapered machined aluminum.The power cord uses a shield type Verden thick cord."

name: CTA504
description:
## Description

"XENA AUDIO tube type stereo power amplifier.The power supply circuits are classified into seven systems, each of which is protected by high-quality film capacitors, and which suppress mutual interference even in the ultra-high frequency band.The power supply section is equipped with a specially designed toroidal transformer of a lorry cage and a capacitor with sufficient pressure resistance margin.To drive the output tube 6550A, a push-pull phase inversion circuit using two bi-triodes is adopted.It uses a 4-mm gold-plated output terminal that can be used with banana plugs, and provides dedicated outputs for 4� and 8� speakers respectively.A gold-plated RCA pin jack is used for the input terminal.The output transformer uses an EI core made of directionally rolled super silicon steel sheet.Especially, the coupling density between the primary and secondary windings is high, and a balance between characteristics and efficiency is maintained.With a knob on the front panel of the hairline finish, you can switch between the A-class pentod connection and the triode connection.The power cord uses a Verden shield type thick cord."
